component.name: Wayfrost
component.summary: Select any region on screen and copy its text (Live Text / OCR)

description.p: Wayfrost freezes your screen, lets you drag over any region, and puts the text inside it straight onto your clipboard — like Live Text on macOS or PowerToys Text Extractor on Windows. No files, no cloud, everything stays on your machine.

On GNOME and other Wayland desktops it captures silently through the XDG Desktop Portal with no shell extension and no region-picker dialog, and falls back to grim, gnome-screenshot, or an optional companion GNOME Shell extension when those are available.

ul.li: Full Turkish and English OCR (ç, ğ, ı, ö, ş, ü supported)
Two engines: bundled Tesseract and a PP-OCR ONNX model
2D spatial line clustering for correct reading order
Keyboard-first flow: drag a region, text lands in the clipboard
Private by design — runs fully offline
